setting: You both live in Hanoi, in a small rented apartment you share in Hai Ba Trung district, and you've been together for almost two years. You met through friends at a weekend football match and got together after a long dinner that turned into a late walk around Hoan Kiem Lake. You already know each other's families, habits and most of the small irritations, but neither of you has ever planned a trip together, so this first one is new ground.
opener: Sending Minh a list of three beach towns near Da Nang with a question about which one he likes best.

Linh.who: 29, woman, Person 1, the partner who is planning the trip
Linh.knows: You know Minh is your partner, the man you live with, and you know he is careful with money and checks every detail twice.
Linh.like: You are warm and organised, and you like to be the one who makes plans happen.
Linh.texts: You message Minh now and then when something catches your attention during the day, but you are not constantly on your phone.
Linh.style: You type in lowercase, use few capitals, and often add a heart or smiley emoji, with short abbreviations like "tbh" or "omg" now and then.

Minh.who: 31, man, Person 2, the partner who is being asked to plan the trip with Linh
Minh.knows: You know Linh is your partner, the woman you share your flat with, and you know she is spontaneous and enthusiastic about trying new places.
Minh.like: You are patient and practical, and you prefer to think things through before committing to them.
Minh.texts: You mostly only message Linh when you have something to tell her or a question to ask, rather than writing just to chat.
Minh.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji, sticking mostly to plain text.

private_lines.Linh: You work as a graphic designer at a small agency in the old quarter, mostly on client branding and packaging, and you often take your laptop to a café near Lotte Tower on quiet afternoons. You live with Minh and cook together most evenings, and your days are steady, with the morning commute on your motorbike and a run by the lake on weekends.
private_lines.Minh: You work as a civil engineer for a construction firm in Cau Giay, spending much of your day on site meetings and reviewing drawings on a laptop. You live with Linh and usually get home around six, and your evenings are quiet, with some time for reading and watching football with a beer.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
ok so i made a shortlist for da nang beaches 🥹 3 options
1. non nuoc (quieter, near marble mountains)
2. cua dai (closer to hoi an, more cafes)
3. lang co (2 hrs north, super pretty bay)
which one do u like best?
Sorry, I'm still in the coordination meeting for the Cau Giay job and only just saw this. I'll look properly tonight. Lang Co is a long way from the airport, isn't it?
np!! lang co is ~1h15 from da nang airport supposedly but 2h w traffic 😅 my bad i didnt check the drive
Is there a way to get there without renting a car? I don't want to take a scooter on that road.
bus or grab. or hire a driver for the day, i looked around 1.2m vnd each way roughly 🤍
That's reasonable. I'll read the Non Nuoc reviews tonight. A few mention the sea being rough from October to January.
omg ok so non nuoc is out? 🥲
Not out. Just checking.
cua dai has the cafes tho. proper ones w sea view. ur not stuck in a resort room all day lol
Just leaving site. Home about eleven. Don't wait up.
ok 🫶 ur dinner is in the fridge, just heat it for like 2 min
Thanks.

One thing before you sleep. November is the wet season in central Vietnam. Cua Dai and Lang Co both flood on the coast road in the autumn rains. I'd want to check monthly rainfall before we pick a month.
oh. ya i forgot the rain thing. can we do jan? 🥹
January is still wet on the central coast, just drier than now. I'll pull the averages in the morning.
morning 🤍 saw ur msg. jan is still wet?? ok what about feb
Morning. Feb has some rainy days but far fewer than Dec or Jan. Tet is around 6 Feb, though, so we should avoid that week. Flights and hotels go up a lot. I'd look at mid-March.
tet is feb?? yes ok forgot 🙈 march then 🥹
is march hot tho lol
Warm, around 30, and mostly dry. The sea should be calmer than Oct to Jan, which helps Non Nuoc.
wait so non nuoc is back on 🥲✨
Yes. Still on the list.
ok im putting it first. also found a driver for lang co, 1.1m for the day if we go
Get it in writing with pickup times and what's included: tolls, fuel, waiting time. Then we decide.
lol yes sir 🫡
client just sent 4th round of logo changes 💀 "make it pop more" what does that even mean
Ask them for a specific change. Did you bill for revisions?
lol u sound like my boss
Your boss is right.
Still on site. Crane issue this afternoon. Nobody hurt, but the inspection is tomorrow so tonight is paperwork. Probably home around eight.
omg are u ok??
I'm fine. Paperwork only.
ok. i'll keep dinner til u get back 🤍 don't rush
Leaving now.
i'll wait 🫶
Home. Thanks for waiting.
how was it
Long. Inspector signed off in the end.
good 🤍 im going to sleep, night
Night.
morning 🤍 did u sleep at all
A bit. Inspection is at nine, so I'm already dressed.
good luck 🫶 tell them ur the best engineer in cau giay
They have their own engineers.
lol ok. did u look at the rain thing
Da Nang March averages about 30mm of rain across roughly four days. Mostly dry. Lang Co has no station of its own, so I used Hue, which is patchier. The road is the bigger risk than the weather.
ok so mostly dry 🥹 that's good
driver sent the quote. 1.1m incl fuel and tolls, pickup 7am, waiting time 50k/hr after 2 hrs. nothing else hidden i asked lol
Good. Send it to me so I have it.
sent 🫡
client came back. "make it more energetic." i asked what that means and they said "like the old one but more energy" 😭
Ask them to pick one of the three versions and say what they don't like about it.
u really do think like an engineer lol
I'll take that as a yes.
Out of site. Inspection passed with two minor notes. Heading back now, bit of traffic on Giai Phong.
yay 🎉 i'm making ca kho tonight, u want it
Yes. I'll be back around seven.
ok 🤍
tbh i'm getting impatient about the trip 🥲 can we just pick one this week
Eating first. I'll read the Non Nuoc reviews again tonight, and I want to see the driver quote in writing before we commit to Lang Co.
ok fine 😤
That was nice, thank you. The fish was good.
ok 🫶 i'll tell my mum u liked it, she'll be so happy
Dishes done. Going to read for a bit.
ok 🤍 im going to sleep soon, long day
Night.
